CD(1)                       General Commands Manual                       CD(1)

NAME
       cd - Change the working directory.

SYNOPSIS
       cd [-L|[-P [-e]] [-@]] [dir]

DESCRIPTION
       Makes DIR the working directory, or $HOME when no DIR is given. `cd -'
       goes back to $OLDPWD.

OPTIONS
       -L     keep symbolic links in the new path (the default)

       -P     resolve symbolic links in the new path

       -e     with -P, fail when the new path cannot be resolved

       -@     accepted, with no effect

EXIT STATUS
       0 when the directory changed, otherwise non-zero.

PWD(1)  General Commands Manual  PWD(1)

NAME
       pwd - Print the working
       directory.

SYNOPSIS
       pwd [-LP]

DESCRIPTION
       Print the working directory.

OPTIONS
       -L     print it as reached,
              symbolic links kept (the
              default)

       -P     print it with symbolic
              links resolved

EXIT STATUS
       0 unless an option is invalid.

Usage: man [OPTION...] [SECTION] PAGE...
MAN(1)                      General Commands Manual                      MAN(1)

NAME
       man - Show the manual page of a command.

SYNOPSIS
       man [OPTION...] [SECTION] PAGE...

DESCRIPTION
       Shows the manual page of each PAGE: what the command does, how to call
       it and its options. The pages are those of the shell's own commands, of
       the commands each mount provides and of the installed CLIs, where a
       subcommand has a page of its own, named after its path with hyphens.
       Every page is in section 1.

OPTIONS
       -a, --all
              show every page that matches PAGE

       -f, --whatis
              print the summary line of each PAGE

       -k, --apropos
              search the names and summaries of every page

       -?, -h, --help
              print this list

       --usage
              print the usage line
